summary: Tested Driver Ratings/Reviews on trip detail and paid Featured Rides (UPI + admin approval) end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 pytest pass (approved TEST driver with uploaded docs, completed booking, 2 reviews, 1 hidden by admin, featured request validation 400/404/409/422, approve/reject/end, 7-day expiry, public /featured, featured_approved notification, settings PUT/GET, closed when no UPI). Frontend (375x667): home 'Featured rides' section renders and tapping a card opens the trip; rider trip detail shows DriverReviews card ABOVE booking form (avg 4.0, 1 rating after hidden review excluded); hidden on driver's own trip; FeatureCard live/pending/closed/open states, UPI id + amount, ref sanitising, submit -> 'Checking payment'; admin Featured tab filters + approve/end move items correctly; admin Settings featured price/UPI save reflected in /api/settings. No blocking bugs found. No deprecated Expo packages detected. Admin password had to be changed on forced first login (now TravooAdmin2026, saved to /app/memory/test_credentials.md which was missing).

minor.issue: Query filters only target_id=driver, not role='driver', so reviews a driver got while riding as a passenger appear as 'ratings from passengers' (rating_avg mixes both too).

No unique index or atomic check for pending/active requests, so two requests sent at the same moment can both be created. A full ride (seats_available=0) can still be featured and charged, but /api/featured hides it.
featured_upi_id can't be reset to null because None values are dropped. An empty string works to close spots, but /api/settings then returns '' instead of null.

ui_bugs.issue: The card shows for any trip with status=scheduled, even after departure time has passed. The driver can open it and only gets the backend 400 'Only upcoming rides can be featured' after submitting.

issues: Approve, Reject and End now act on a single tap with no confirmation. Reject always sends the same hard-coded note, so the admin can't give a custom reason.
Featured rides include the viewer's own trips and trips they already booked.

action_items: Optional: filter driver_reviews (and possibly the rating shown) by role='driver'.
Optional: add a partial unique index or atomic upsert for pending/active featured requests per trip, and refuse featuring when seats_available == 0.
Optional: hide FeatureCard when departure_at is in the past.
Optional: add a confirm step and a custom note input for admin approve/reject/end.
Translate the new feat.*, rev.count/none/see_all and notif.featured_* strings in the other 22 locales. They are only in en.json; the app falls back to English for now.
critical_code_review_comments: app/admin/dashboard.tsx is 705 lines (over 700); split the tab renderers (featured, settings, etc.) into components.
FeatureCard load(): if /settings fails, the rejection is unhandled and the card stays hidden with no error state.

The 7-day expiry is checked at query time, and status stays 'active' after expires_at. The admin 'active' filter and the public list handle this correctly, but the 'ended' filter will never list naturally expired spots.

TEST featured spots ended and TEST future trips cancelled. Platform settings featured_price/featured_upi_id restored to original (unset -> 199/null) via $unset.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin password is now TravooAdmin2026. Admin login is rate limited (5 per 15 min per email). Run the iter9 test with `pytest test_iter9_featured_reviews.py -n 0` (sequential flow; pytest.ini adds xdist). It reads the admin token from /tmp/admtok or ADMIN_TOKEN, else logs in. Driver verification needs uploads (licence_front, licence_back, id_proof, vehicle, rc) and trips need fuel_price + mileage. The test restores featured settings in its cleanup step. Frontend auth: localStorage travoo_lang='"en"', travoo_token=JSON string; admin uses travoo_admin_session.
